item.title: [IGNITE-2124] Deserialization of a BinaryObject key on a remote node
item.description:
BinaryObject key gets deserialized on a remote node. In my understanding this mustn't happen when BinaryMarshaller is enabled.

Steps to reproduce:

  • start a remote node using ignite.bat/sh;
  • launch CacheClientBinaryQueryExample;

The example will fail with the following stack trace:

comments.comment: Tested using the latest sources from 1.5 branch.

IGNITE-2124 - Do not notify DS manager for user caches, use correct simple names for queries

You can merge this pull request into a Git repository by running:

$ git pull https://github.com/agoncharuk/ignite ignite-2124

Alternatively you can review and apply these changes as the patch at:

https://github.com/apache/ignite/pull/313.patch

To close this pull request, make a commit to your master/trunk branch
with (at least) the following in the commit message:

This closes #313
